name: Robotcore
summary: Robotcore is an aesthetic utilizing the more technical and complex elements of technological aesthetics, with people using them to express their fascination of these ideas and motifs.
description: Robotcore is an aesthetic utilizing the more technical and complex elements of technological aesthetics, with people using them to express their fascination of these ideas and motifs. This aesthetic is sometimes used to personify and add anthropomorphic qualities to robots, computers, and AI. The aesthetic is based on futurism and robots; it is a glimpse into a world where robots dominate and rule the world, how their society would function, and how it would look. The aesthetic puts heavy emphasis on robots as the name suggests, however it is more than just robots; it's the tech and the parts and the idea of robot sentience, and the colors and civilization they create.
culturalContext: Key values (per the Aesthetics Wiki): Independency

activities: Cosplaying as robot and/or android characters
Making and/or tinkering with robots and their parts
